cardOverview.overviewText: A Samman card dedicated to government and defense personnel, offering simple rewards, fee waivers, and essential lifestyle perks.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Avail one free movie ticket every six months with the Samman Credit Card. All cardholders are eligible for two complimentary movie tickets every year, i.e., one every six months.|The maximum value for the movie ticket shall not exceed ₹200.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
